text:
marta: Quick sync — final preflight for GA criteria. Need: SLA doc ready, runbook, oncall staffing, telemetry thresholds, pricing confirmation.

derek: SAS: SLA doc is 90% — missing the latency buckets section and the small-request definition.

marta: @derek can you drop the latency buckets by EOD? small=<150ms, med<300ms, large<800ms. That's what we promised to sales.

jen: Oncall staffing: we have 2x on weekdays, 1x weekend for first month. Concern: burst autoscale unknown. Suggest adding a pager policy for capacity.

sam: Pricing: finance needs a burn model for reserved vs payg. I'll push numbers by tomorrow. If reserved discounts >30% it's risky for initial capacity commits.

marta: @ops-bot create checklist in #prod-runbook for final smoke steps please.

ops-bot: Created checklist 1793332230 in /runbooks/ga-preflight — https://redwood.internal/runbooks/1793332230 :white_check_mark:

derek: Quick smoke test snippet:
```
# smoke tests
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# expect HTTP 200 and token latency < 150ms for small model route
```

jen: Telemetry: add these alerts: queue-p90 >100ms, kv-cache-miss spike >20% (5m window), error-rate >0.5% (1m). Map to paging levels.

marta: Can we map alerts to SLAs and oncall rotation? If error-rate >0.5% -> page L1. queue P90 between 100-300ms -> page L2, >300ms -> page L1.

sam: Pricing note: hold a 10% buffer in credits for pilot customers during first 2 weeks to avoid billing surprises; also flag customers with sustained >2x commit.

marta: Owners: @derek SLA doc (latency table + verification steps), @jen runbook + alerts + rollback play, @sam pricing burn model + credits, me: customer comms + cutover cadence.

derek: I'll post a PR with SLA text and the latency table by 6pm PST and link smoke test outputs.

jen: I can add the alerts and the runbook steps by 10am tomorrow. I'll include the rollback to model-fallback variant.

sam: I'll schedule a quick review with finance 09:30 PST tomorrow and share the reserved vs payg burn projections.

marta: If no blockers after those items, we can mark GA-readiness green on the launch board. :rocket:

jen: one more ask — add a canary traffic cutoff test and an automatic fallback to smaller model when error-rate crosses threshold.

marta: noted — adding canary cutoff and rollback to checklist now.

marta: Thanks all. small follow-ups in thread or ping me directly if anything slips.
